critical_competencies.name: F2 Framing
critical_competencies.proof: Bounded decision-linked question; facts separated from assumptions.

critical_competencies.name: F3 Metric/KPI
critical_competencies.proof: Reproducible metric definition; explicit eligible denominator for a rate; unresolved rules visible.

critical_competencies.name: F4 Grain/Data
critical_competencies.proof: Correct source/result grain; legitimate repetition; minimum required fields/rules.

critical_competencies.name: F5 Data Quality
critical_competencies.proof: Five scenario-specific checks with impact/next action.

critical_competencies.name: F6 Validation/DoD
critical_competencies.proof: Internal validation, comparable reconciliation, sanity check, assumptions/limitations, testable Definition of Done.

critical_competencies.name: F1 Decision Support
critical_competencies.proof: Interpretation stays within evidence and supports the stated decision without unsupported cause claims.

pass_rule: ALL critical competencies PASS AND no critical failure; no percentage average
critical_failures: invented business definition hidden as fact
expected many-row history treated as duplicate records

A.on_fail: SAVE_ATTEMPT -> REVIEW_A -> TARGETED_REPAIR -> CHANGED_RETRY -> explicit B assignment only

B.unlock: failed A + saved A attempt + Review A + repair evidence + explicit assignment
B.on_fail: SAVE_ATTEMPT -> REVIEW_B -> SECOND_REPAIR -> CHANGED_RETRY -> explicit C assignment only

C.unlock: failed B + saved B attempt + Review B + second repair evidence + explicit assignment
